title: F2 alt: 'LAYER TWO' (K2 corrected ending) interpreted as multi-role instruction
hypothesis_summary: K2's corrected ending is 'LAYER TWO' — the X separator that produces this reading was admitted by Sanborn (anomaly registry A1). The most aggressive reading is that K2's plaintext literally instructs that K4 has a second layer; less aggressive readings treat 'LAYER TWO' as thematic. This pack tests the literal reading as a 3-layer Vig+col+rail composition with the LAYER and TWO words used as keyword candidates alongside the core crib pool. Provenance is the K2 plaintext itself, which is Tier-1 disclosed (so the WORDS are evidence) plus a Tier-3 claim about what they MEAN (so the COMPOSITION-as-instruction reading is hearsay).

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Anomaly A1: K2 corrected ending is X-LAYER-TWO; Sanborn admitted error 2006. Disclosed plaintext.
Community/community-derived reading that LAYER TWO instructs a second cipher layer for K4 (Tier-3 hearsay).

composition_templates.rationale: LAYER TWO as 3-role instruction; LAYER as columnar key, depth literal '2' or rail-defaults.

constraints: Keywords restricted to LAYER and LAYERTWO; depths to {2, 3, 4}.
caveats: ALTERNATIVE-MECHANISM framing within the F2 family.

The 'LAYER TWO instructs a second layer for K4' reading is Tier-3 community interpretation, not creator confirmation. Sanborn corrected the K2 ending in 2006 but has not endorsed this instruction reading.
